message: Hi, my kid Iris is 9 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for ages 7-12, so Iris would be a great fit. It's a really fun program and perfect for her age. Are you interested in scheduling a free trial class for her?
Yes, I'd love to schedule a free trial class for Iris! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I grab your email address? I'll send you the trial confirmation there.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And what's Iris's date of birth? I need that to get her scheduled.

Perfect! Here are some available times for Iris's free trial class:

- Wednesday, July 8 at 6:30 PM
- Monday, July 13 at 6:30 PM
- Wednesday, July 15 at 6:30 PM

Which one works best for you?
Let's go with Wednesday, July 8 at 6:30 PM.

Perfect! Iris is all set for her free trial class on Wednesday, July 8 at 6:30 PM. You'll get a confirmation email at tester.flint@gmail.com. Just bring Iris in comfortable workout clothes. See you then!
